name: Hilchenbach (Germany)
description: Hanging banner of orange-yellow with narrow blue stripes along both edges, charged at the top with the city arms of Hilchenbach (a yellow castle and a wolf on blue beneath a mural crown).
history: The arms were most recently granted on 13 April 1970; the banner of the city shows the arms on a yellow (orange-coloured) stripe accompanied by two narrow blue side stripes.

features.role: Hilchenbach arms — castle and wolf on blue
